posts.title: Leadership, Management, and Supervision in AI Work
posts.description: Why working with AI agents feels like leadership to me: setting direction, creating alignment, and reviewing execution without scripting every step.

posts.title: Working With AI Feels More Like Leadership Than Coding
posts.description: Working with AI is less predictable than traditional software. That makes leadership skills such as context, clarity, and feedback more valuable.
